fecycle and enablement stack The Ubuntu LTS enablement, or Hardware Enablement (HWE), stack provides newer kernel and X11 display support for existing Ubuntu LTS releases. That stack can be enabled manually, but may also be pre-enabled with an Ubuntu LTS release. The HWE stack can be used by desktop and server systems, as well as cloud or virtual images.
